Staffel 1・"FaceOff: Inside the NHL" gives an unprecedented, unfiltered look into the lives of the greatest hockey players in the NHL chasing the hardest trophy to win in sports: the Stanley Cup.

Jeremiah Johnson battles to rebuild his career after a shooting left him temporarily paralyzed.

Quarterback Jayden Daniels verfolgt seine NFL-Träume, während vor einem Showdown mit Erzrivale Alabama die Hoffnungen von Louisiana auf seinen Schultern lasten.
